title: Editable pixel eraser
summary: Erase to transparency with a smooth brush, keep strokes editable, and restore a complete gesture with one Undo.

Added: More > Eraser supports click dots and freehand strokes across the image and earlier annotations.
Drawing previews actual transparent pixels. Width and opacity edits update the selected stroke live.
Move eraser strokes and resize their bounds; save editable projects or copy/export flattened transparent output.
Verified: Native stroke creation, one-step Undo/Redo, opacity drag, movement and saved output pass synthetic checks.
An independent alpha-mask calculation matches all 256000 saved pixels; the actual Windows clipboard matches the same image.
Engine checks cover transparent input, stroke crossings, edge clipping, stacking, original retention and invalid paths.

limitations: Smooth round brushes support widths from 1 to 32 pixels. Brush presets and a hard-edge antialias toggle are unfinished.
Erasers affect the image and objects below them in the stack. Editable projects retain original image pixels.
This unsigned Windows alpha does not claim complete Snagit interface or behavior parity.
